correctness.rationale: The boundary congruence and binomial comparator withstand independent checks. Using T(x)^m=(1-x)^m T(x²)^m, exact integer recurrence computations for every 2≤A≤8 and every odd 1≤v≤31 verified t_{2+2^A v}(2^A−1)≡2^A(v−1) mod 2^{A+2} and ν2 binom(2^A(v+1),2^A−1)=A+ν2(v+1). The proof's valuation separation by v mod 4 is therefore correct, and the reduction from m=2u with odd u>1 to A=ν2(u−1)+1 supplies the claimed explicit violating index. The argument's dyadic coefficient lemma, convolution error bounds, pairing modulo four, and Kummer/Legendre comparator are internally consistent with these exact computations.

originality.rationale: PASS on the uniform theorem, with one prior special case excluded from the novelty claim. The earlier SCOPE record `2026/09/17/exact-tenth-power-thue-morse-valuations--2cde9accbbd3` gives the much more detailed m=10 valuation formula, so the m=10 example itself is prior repository work. Shen's September 2026 source abstract advertises exact binomial valuations for powers of two and for 3·2^r (r≥2), plus a corrected m=6 formula, but not a uniform obstruction for all m=2u with u odd. Targeted searches did not locate the boundary congruence or complete r=1 classification. Thus the original contribution is the all-twice-odd obstruction and explicit witness map, not its already-known m=10 instance.

scientific_value.rationale: The theorem resolves an infinite layer of Shen's conjectural classification in one stroke and gives an explicit witness n=2^{ν2(u−1)+1}−1 for every excluded twice-odd exponent. This is materially stronger than isolated exponent computations and exposes a clean 2-adic mechanism behind failure of the binomial baseline.

citations.note: Zhao Shen, Powers of the Thue--Morse Series: 2-Adic Valuations and Automatic Odd Parts (2026); motivating conjectural framework and exact families advertised in the abstract.
Gawron–Miska–Ulas, arithmetic properties of powers of the Thue–Morse product; foundational exact valuation results.
Earlier SCOPE exact m=10 formula; overlap explicitly excluded from novelty.

independent_checks: Implemented the exact coefficient recurrence from T(x)^m=(1-x)^m T(x²)^m and tested 112 (A,v) pairs with 2≤A≤8 and odd v≤31; all congruence and valuation checks passed.
Verified the example t_10(7)=-1600 with ν2=6 while binom(16,9) has ν2=4.
Checked the algebra reducing arbitrary m=2u, odd u>1, to N=2^{ν2(u−1)+1} and odd v=(u−1)/2^{ν2(u−1)}.
Compared the theorem with the earlier exact m=10 SCOPE record and treated that exponent as prior art rather than as novelty.
limitations: The theorem settles only the ν2(m)=1/r=1 layer; it does not prove the general r≥2 conjecture.
The m=10 instance is already covered more strongly by an earlier SCOPE record.
The motivating preprint is very recent, so contemporaneous unindexed work remains a residual priority risk.
